login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage edutourism sessions.

login.title: Every learning journey starts here.
login.body: Run edutourism sessions, track each child's progress, and send meaningful reports home, all in one place.
login.tag: Learning beyond the classroom, growing together.

register.title: Bring your team along.
register.body: Register admins and facilitators, then build programs that make children want to learn again.

forgot.title: Lost access? We'll guide you back.
forgot.body: Enter your registered email to receive a reset code, or ask your school admin for a new one.
forgot.tag: No one gets left behind on the journey.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Register as an admin or facilitator. The account activates after approval.
register.name: Name
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including letters and numbers.
register.pending: Registration submitted. Waiting for admin approval.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your registered email to get a reset code.
forgot.success: If the email is registered, a reset code will be sent. If you receive nothing, ask your admin for the code.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.codeHint: The 8-character code from the email or the admin dashboard.

validation.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, including letters and numbers.
validation.waDigits: WhatsApp number may only contain digits.
validation.waInvalid: Invalid WhatsApp number. Use the 08…, 8…, or 62… format.

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.subtitle: Overview of children, sessions, and assessments for the active school.
dash.emptyProgress: No sessions have open assessments yet.

schools.title: Schools
schools.subtitle: Manage schools, active status, and permanent deletion.
schools.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this school? No member will be able to sign in.
schools.deleteBody: All school rows and server photo files are deleted too. wa_outbox history is retained for 90 days.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage admins and facilitators: approvals, status, and permanent deletion.
users.name: Name
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? Their other sessions are signed out immediately.
users.deleteBody: The user row is deleted permanently. Assessment history is kept with snapped names.
users.openGroups: This user still leads the following groups — reassign them first:

users.impersonationBanner: Signed in as {{name}} ({{role}}) on behalf of {{actor}}.
users.resetGeneratedWarning: This password is shown only once. Copy it before confirming.
users.resetPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, including letters and numbers.

reset.revealedNote: The code is shown once and recorded in the audit log.
